arxiv-2104-02059.title: Distributed Deep Reinforcement Learning for Collaborative Spectrum Sharing
arxiv-2104-02059.creator: Pranav M. Pawar, Amir Leshem
arxiv-2104-02059.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Pranav M. Pawar, Amir Leshem. Spectrum sharing among users is a fundamental problem in the management of any wireless network. In this paper, we discuss the problem of distributed spectrum collaboration without central management under general unknown channels. Since the cost of communication, coordination and control is rapidly increasing with the number of devices and the expanding bandwidth used there is an obvious need to develop distributed techniques for spectrum collaboration where no explicit signaling is used.

arxiv-2106-08082.creator: Patrik Lundström

arxiv-2108-12209.title: Exponential clustering of bipartite quantum entanglement at arbitrary temperatures
arxiv-2108-12209.creator: Tomotaka Kuwahara 1,2 and Keiji Saito 3
arxiv-2108-12209.description: Abstract Many inexplicable phenomena in low-temperature many-body physics are a result of macroscopic quantum effects. Such macroscopic quantumness is often evaluated via long-range entanglement, that is, entanglement in the macroscopic length scale. Long-range entanglement is employed to characterize novel quantum phases and serves as a critical resource for quantum computation.

arxiv-2201-03586.title: The chaotic history of the retrograde multi-planet system in K2-290A driven by distant stars
arxiv-2201-03586.creator: Marcela Best, Cristobal Petrovich
arxiv-2201-03586.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Marcela Best, Cristobal Petrovich. The equator of star K2-290A was recently found to be inclined by 124 ± 6 124\pm 6 degrees relative to the orbits of both its known transiting planets. The presence of a companion star B at ∼ 100 \sim 100 au suggested that the birth protoplanetary disk could have tilted, thus providing an explanation for the peculiar retrograde state of this multi-planet system.

arxiv-2206-03039.title: The Origin of Deformation Induced Topological Anisotropy in Silica Glass Journal: Acta Materialia
arxiv-2206-03039.creator: Sudheer Ganisetti, Achraf Atila, Julien Guénolé, Aruna Prakash, Jürgen Horbach, Lothar Wondraczek, Erik Bitzek
arxiv-2206-03039.description: Abstract Oxide glasses with a network structure are omnipresent in daily life. Often, they are regarded as isotropic materials; however, structural anisotropy can be induced through processing in mechanical fields and leads to unique materials properties. Unfortunately, due to the lack of local, atomic-scale analysis methods, the microscopic mechanisms leading to anisotropy remained elusive.

arxiv-2212-11426.title: GeV gamma-ray emission from pulsar wind nebula HESS J1356-645 with Fermi -LAT
arxiv-2212-11426.creator: Xi Liu, Xiaolei Guo, Yuliang Xin, Fengrong Zhu, Siming Liu
arxiv-2212-11426.description: Abstract HESS J1356-645 is considered to be a pulsar wind nebula (PWN) associated with the pulsar PSR J1357-6429. We reanalyze the GeV gamma-ray emission in the direction of HESS J1356-645 with more than 13 years of Fermi Large Area Telescope (LAT) data. The extended gamma-ray emission above 5 GeV is found to be spatially coincident with HESS J1356-645.

arxiv-2304-12236.creator: R. Abbasi, M. Ackermann, J. Adams, S. K. Agarwalla, J. A. Aguilar, M. Ahlers, J.M. Alameddine, N. M. Amin, K. Andeen, G. Anton, C. Argüelles, Y. Ashida, S. Athanasiadou, S. N. Axani, X. Bai, A. Balagopal V, M. Baricevic, S. W. Barwick, V. Basu, R. Bay, J. J. Beatty, K.-H. Becker, J. Becker Tjus, J.
arxiv-2304-12236.description: Abstract We describe a new data sample of IceCube DeepCore and report on the latest measurement of atmospheric neutrino oscillations obtained with data recorded between 2011-2019. The sample includes significant improvements in data calibration, detector simulation, and data processing, and the analysis benefits from a sophisticated treatment of systematic uncertainties, with significantly greater level of detail since our last study.

arxiv-2411-01174.title: Leveraging LLM and Text-Queried Separation for Noise-Robust Sound Event Detection
arxiv-2411-01174.creator: Han Yin 1 , Yang Xiao 2 , Jisheng Bai 1 , Rohan Kumar Das 2
arxiv-2411-01174.description: Abstract Sound Event Detection (SED) is challenging in noisy environments where overlapping sounds obscure target events. Language-queried audio source separation (LASS) aims to isolate the target sound events from a noisy clip. However, this approach can fail when the exact target sound is unknown, particularly in noisy test sets, leading to reduced performance.

arxiv-2510-13951.title: Decoherence in high energy collisions as renormalization group flow
arxiv-2510-13951.creator: Jiayin Gu, Shi-Jia Lin, Ding Yu Shao, Lian-Tao Wang, Si-Xiang Yang
arxiv-2510-13951.description: Abstract The unification of quantum information science and collider physics is opening a new frontier in high-energy experiments, making a systematic understanding of decoherence a critical challenge. We present a framework to systematically compute spin decoherence from final-state radiation by combining soft-collinear effective theory and open quantum system techniques.

pmc-11690487.title: THE IMPACT OF EDUCATIONAL LEVEL ON FOOD SECURITY AMONG OLDER ADULTS AMID THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC
pmc-11690487.creator: Lillie Monroe-Lord, Azam Ardekani, Phronie Jackson, Cassidy Weitman
pmc-11690487.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The COVID-19 pandemic has dramatically altered global health and economic landscapes, significantly threatening food security worldwide. This study investigates the pandemic’s impact on perceived food security among older adults, with a particular focus on the role of educational attainment. A total of 4,961 participants aged 65 and above were surveyed between August 9 and September 15, 2020, utilizing the USDA’s Six-Item Short Form via Qualtrics to measure food security.

pmc-11710798.title: Tangle distribution is differentially influenced by age at onset, APOE ε4, and MAPT H1 along the corticolimbic axis
pmc-11710798.creator: Baayla D C Boon
pmc-11710798.description: BackgroundAlzheimer’s disease (AD) is heterogeneous in both its clinical and neuropathologic course. Age at onset and distribution of corticolimbic tangles can vary widely among individuals. Genetic risk factors APOE ε4 and MAPT H1 increase AD risk. However, the association with the spatial distribution of pathology remains a key gap in knowledge.

pmc-11715469.description: BackgroundPhysiological changes, including metabolic and cellular aging, as well as increased inflammation, occur in people living with dementia (PWD). While there is existing evidence in other populations suggesting that exercise may improve physiological outcomes, their impact in PWD remains unclear.

pmc-12473324.creator: Anastasios C. Patsidis, Ioanna Th. Papageorgiou, Zoi G. Lada
pmc-12473324.description: Polymer-based hybrid composites have emerged as promising platforms for multifunctional energy applications, combining structural versatility with tunable dielectric behavior. In this study, synthesized [Fe(bpy)3]SO4; (tris(2,2′-bipyridine)iron(II) sulfate) coordination compound was incorporated into a green epoxy resin matrix to fabricate nanocomposites aimed at enhancing dielectric permittivity (ε′), piezoelectric coefficient (d33, pC/N), energy-storage efficiency (nrel, %), and mechanical strength (σ, MPa).

pmc-12548448.creator: Maia E. Alberts, Micaila P. Kurtz, Ute Müh, Jonathon P. Bernardi, Kevin W. Bollinger, Horia A. Dobrila, Leonard Duncan, Hannah M. Laster, Andres J. Orea, Anthony G. Pannullo, Juan G. Rivera-Rosado, Facundo V. Torres, Craig D. Ellermeier, David S. Weiss
pmc-12548448.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Essential genes are interesting in their own right and as potential antibiotic targets. To date, only one report has identified essential genes on a genome-wide scale in Clostridioides difficile, a problematic pathogen for which treatment options are limited. That foundational study used large-scale transposon mutagenesis to identify 404 protein-encoding genes as likely to be essential for vegetative growth of the epidemic strain R20291.

pmc-13095646.description: The pervasiveness of obesity necessitates expanded pursuits to understand mechanistic drivers of the condition. pmc-13230595.title: Associations between per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), DNA methylation and gene expression from background exposed Norwegian women (2003–2006)
pmc-13230595.creator: Ana Carolina M F Coêlho, Torkjel M Sandanger, Dorte Herzke, Charlotta Rylander, Vivian Berg, Therese Haugdahl Nøst
pmc-13230595.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS) are a large group of widespread synthetic substances associated with several adverse health effects. A potential mechanism underlying these effects is epigenetic modifications, such as DNA methylation. However, evidence on associations between PFAS exposure and DNA methylation among adults is limited, and few studies have investigated the potential influence of PFAS-related methylation changes on gene expression. In this study, we investigated associations between PFAS exposure and DNA methylation in blood.

pmc-13314165.title: Environmental evaluation of PAH bioaccumulation in common sea bream (Pagrus pagrus) from Benghazi Port, Libya
